saga_economical_heavy.name: Economical Heavy
saga_economical_heavy.description: Heavy attacks cost 2 less stamina, to a minimum of 1.

saga_follow_through.name: Follow Through
saga_follow_through.description: Light attack recovery is 8% shorter. Blade contact remains synchronized.

saga_deep_reserve.name: Deep Reserve
saga_deep_reserve.description: Maximum stamina increases by 10. Learning does not refill stamina.

saga_staying_power.name: Staying Power
saga_staying_power.description: Maximum health increases by another 10. Learning does not heal.

saga_clean_release.name: Clean Release
saga_clean_release.description: Fully drawn arrows deal 5% more damage to hostile targets. Training shots are unchanged.

saga_ready_string.name: Ready String
saga_ready_string.description: Bow recovery is 0.03 seconds shorter after Quick Nock, to a minimum of 0.10 seconds.

saga_banked_embers.name: Banked Embers
saga_banked_embers.description: Oathfire costs another 5 less stamina, to a minimum of 1.

saga_steady_channel.name: Steady Channel
saga_steady_channel.description: Oathfire charges 5% faster. Initial facing and damage timing remain locked to the cast.

keen_edge.name: Keen Edge
keen_edge.description: Maintain the hunter's edge: blade attacks deal 10% more damage. Preparation helps; it cannot decide whose account is true.

measured_riposte.name: Measured Riposte
measured_riposte.description: Recover your breath after a clean read: a successful parry restores 15 stamina. Useful when you need an opening rather than a killing blow.

fell_weight.name: Fell Weight
fell_weight.description: Commit to a deliberate strike: heavy attacks gain a 20% damage multiplier in addition to your blade practice. Their stamina cost still applies.

hardened_vow.name: Hardened Vow
hardened_vow.description: Learn to stay on your feet: maximum health increases by 20. This grants room to recover from a mistake, not immunity.

sure_step.name: Sure Step
sure_step.description: Keep a reserve for the next attack: dodging costs 5 less stamina. Step clear of a telegraph instead of trading blows.

redroot_lore.name: Redroot Lore
redroot_lore.description: Make each remedy count: Redroot Potions restore 15 additional health. This applies to purchased and crafted potions alike.

kindled_core.name: Kindled Core
kindled_core.description: Control the flame's demand: Oathfire costs 10 less stamina. Keep enough breath to defend after using it.

far_reach.name: Far Reach
far_reach.description: Work from a safer distance: Oathfire range increases by 2 metres. Clear sight and a readable opening still matter.

ashen_flow.name: Ashen Flow
ashen_flow.description: Recover the flame sooner: Oathfire cooldown is reduced by 1 second. Its range and stamina rules remain in force.

steady_hands.name: Steady Hands
steady_hands.description: While aiming the bow, reduce look-input sensitivity by 20% for finer placement. Your sensitivity, inversion and aim-assist preferences still apply. No automatic target acquisition.

quick_nock.name: Quick Nock
quick_nock.description: Recover 25% faster between bow shots. Aiming and ammunition are still required; arrow damage and target selection are unchanged.

fletchers_care.name: Fletcher's Care
fletchers_care.description: Recover the finishing Standard or Bodkin arrow after a bow kill. It returns directly to your quiver if there is room. Ashfire arrows burn away; training shots grant no ammunition.
